result: SGD on a wide two-layer network is tracked by a PDE for the distribution of neurons with error O(1/√N) whose constant does not depend on the dimension (step size must be ≪ 1/D); the analysis extends to unbounded activations and noisy SGD, and kernel ridge regression appears as a special scaling limit.
result_plain: Mean-field theory with dimension-free 1/√N approximation bounds; kernel regression as a limit.
